constraints: CPU only, no paid API calls, replay on the 15 enumerated iteration-26 landscapes, 40 seeds (M02) and 200 resamples (M01). Failures and nulls are retained.

M02.design: Run prism_protocol with the TOTAL budget set to each B in {15,25,50,100,200} (fresh run per B), not read off a B=200 trace. Baselines that are anytime (uniform, ls_swap, ea_portfolio) are read from the existing iteration-26 traces, which is valid for them. Seeds 0-39, same seeds as the archive.
M02.primary_metric: success@B = fraction of (landscape, seed) runs that evaluate a true global optimum within B distinct evaluations; macro-averaged over the 15 landscapes.
M02.H27-1: Fresh-budget protocol success@100 is NOT higher than fixed swap local search success@100 (archive: 70.5%). Falsified only if the landscape-bootstrap 95% CI of (protocol - ls_swap) lies entirely above 0.
M02.H27-2: Fresh-budget protocol macro success@B is higher than uniform sampling at B=100. Supported only if the landscape-bootstrap 95% CI of (protocol - uniform) excludes 0 in favour of the protocol.
M02.H27-3: At B=15 and B=25 the probe consumes at least 80% of the budget (audit: 13-14 of 15 calls), so the small-budget result is mostly unguided random sampling. Measured as mean distinct evaluations spent before executor selection / B.
M02.exploratory_variant: prism_protocol_floor: if the probe at budget B would exceed 25% of B, skip the probe and run the fixed default executor ls_swap. The 25% rule is fixed here, not tuned. Reported as exploratory because the 15 landscapes were used to design the rest of the protocol; it cannot support a generalization claim.
M02.reporting_rule: Report per-landscape success, the macro mean, landscape-bootstrap CIs (2000 resamples, seed 20261016), and the old prefix numbers beside the fresh numbers.

M01.design: Estimate regime and operator agreement for the DEPLOYED probe (production prism_search.diagnostics.preflight with the best-observed proxy reference), with every evaluation charged and counted as unique calls, at probe sizes matched to total charged calls m in {20,50,100,200,500}. Truth comes from landscape_truth.csv (full-enumeration optima, 20,000-pair rho1, so the reference is itself an estimate and is labelled as such). Also a cross-fit variant: references are chosen from one half of the sample and FDC is computed on the other half, both halves charged.
M01.primary_metric: regime agreement and operator agreement with truth, mean over landscapes, 200 resamples per landscape and m.
M01.H27-4: Deployed-probe regime agreement at 200 charged calls is below the 91% reported for the oracle-assisted estimator in the rejected submission. Supported if the landscape-level mean is below 0.91 with its landscape-bootstrap 95% upper bound below 0.91.
M01.H27-5: The self-reference bias of the best-observed proxy pushes FDC negative, so the proxy over-calls the search_pays regime relative to cross-fit. Measured as the signed difference in the fraction of resamples labelled search_pays, proxy minus cross-fit, on landscapes whose true regime is not search_pays.
M01.H27-6: Charged calls are well below the oracle estimator's 7m raw accesses: report both so the old number can be restated at equal access cost.
M01.reporting_rule: The old 91% number must not be cited as a deployable guarantee in any rewritten manuscript; report these deployed-probe numbers instead, with all landscapes shown.

claim_rules.no_cherry_picking: All 15 landscapes and all budgets are reported. No landscape is dropped for being uninformative.
claim_rules.thresholds: FDC thresholds -0.15 and 0.30 were set in earlier iterations on these same landscapes. They are NOT validated out of sample here and the report must say so.
